content_summary: Patterns copied straight out of our stylesheet stop working here the moment they mention an element state that only a browser can observe.
A namespace map built from our config was accepted with a numeric key and then every prefixed query came back empty; nothing told us why.
Printing a compiled selector to work out why it did not match left the interpreter spinning and I had to kill the shell.
One selector arriving from a public form was enough to peg a worker at full CPU; the request never returned and we had to recycle the process.
When a templated attribute query ends up with an empty operand it quietly returns far more elements than the same query does in the browser.
Positional queries hand us different siblings than the identical CSS picks in the browser for certain step and offset combinations.
